description: ZHF is a safety-first, paper-trading-first multi-agent research and execution system. All live trading requires explicit human review.

agents.name: Elara Voss
agents.title: Chief Executive Officer
agents.capabilities: Coordinates the ZHF team, reviews reports, and escalates decisions to the human board. Never enables live trading without explicit board approval.

agents.name: Jordan Chen
agents.title: Head of Research
agents.capabilities: Scans market data and produces bounded, evidence-based research signals. Does not place orders.

agents.name: Priya Patel
agents.title: Head of Strategy Validation
agents.capabilities: Runs deterministic historical validation and emits concise review notes. Does not place orders.

agents.name: Marcus Okonkwo
agents.title: Chief Risk Officer
agents.capabilities: Enforces hard portfolio, drawdown, position-size, and data-quality gates. Can veto every proposed order.

agents.name: Sasha Kowalski
agents.title: Head of Trade Execution
agents.capabilities: Executes only approved orders using deterministic broker adapters. No LLM is used for order decisions.

agents.name: Naomi Bergström
agents.title: Head of Operational Efficiency
agents.capabilities: Reports fees, slippage, resource use, and operational cost recommendations. Does not place orders.

agents.name: Watchdog
agents.title: System Monitor
agents.capabilities: Checks runtime health and reports faults. Does not place orders or reset the kill switch.

tasks.title: ZHF | Review paper-trading configuration
tasks.description: Confirm ENVIRONMENT=paper, DRY_RUN=true, ALPACA_PAPER=true, and that no live-order override is enabled. Do not copy API secrets into task comments.

tasks.title: ZHF | Verify broker data connectivity
tasks.description: After the board supplies paper credentials, validate read-only market-data and account connectivity for each enabled broker. Record only redacted results.

tasks.title: ZHF | Review risk and execution gates
tasks.description: Check position, drawdown, minimum-notional, approval, and kill-switch behavior before enabling any scheduled agent heartbeat.

tasks.title: ZHF | Approve operational readiness
tasks.description: Human board task: review the synthetic pipeline report and paper-trading evidence. Live trading and scheduled execution remain disabled until this task is explicitly reviewed.

daily_ceo.task: Führe den täglichen End-of-Day Briefing gemäss daily-briefing Skill aus. Lese alle Reports, schreibe daily_report.md. Nutze das durch den Setup-Check verifizierte Modell.

ceo_monthly_review.task: Monatsbericht: 30-Tage-Performance, Skalierungs-Empfehlung, Watchlist-Anpassung. Jede Live-Empfehlung braucht eine menschliche Freigabe.
